profile.headline: Java Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Performance-driven and self motivated software engineer with over 15 years of experience in software development. Hardworking, highly motivated, fast learner and team focused engineer eager to continue learning new technologies and to deliver the most value to the business. 

Technical Skills
Spring, Spring Boot, Java, Kafka, CQRS, Event Sourcing, J2EE, Groovy, PHP, Grails, Apache Wicket, JBPM, RESTful Web Services, Microservices, GraphQL, Domain Driven Design,  AngularJS, jQuery, SmartClient, Sencha ExtJS, JSP, Servlets, Apache PDFBox, HTML5, Bootstrap, JavaScript, JSON, Ajax, XML, SQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Hibernate, Solr, Agile, SCRUM, UML, JUnit, Pact, Mockito, Spock, Maven, Graddle, Git, SVN, Jenkins, Wildfly, JBoss Application Server, Tomcat, Jetty, AWS, Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Team lead and backend developer of clinical Applications in the HealthCare industry. 
Assisted with the development and implementation of multiple features and parts of EMR software that helps manage patients health needs as well as primary care providers with better tools to improve patient outcomes. It also helps  to provide better service and financial outcomes for the medical centers.
Served as a team lead, collaborating on innovative solutions with managers and architects as well as supervising, guiding and monitoring team members with progress toward priorities and timely delivery of goals.
Collaborated on multiple teams in the overhaul of legacy EMR to modernize and facilitate the doctor-patient experience.
Built and maintained REST APIs with a solution-oriented mindset.
Successfully implemented and deployed multiple bug fixes and features such as Patient Check-in and Checkout, Copay and FAW,  Screenings, Problems, Post covid Telehealth compliance, by meeting strict deadlines and adding value to the business.
Worked in the development and  transition from a monolithic application to a microservice architecture for the EMR software to improve scalability and performance with technologies such as RESTFul APIs, Microservices, JSON, Java/J2EE, Maven, Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, MySQL, Solr, GraphQL.
Built and developed  scalable and performance driven applications using Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB, CQRS, and TDD.
Maintained stability in legacy applications by promptly addressing and resolving unexpected issues,alerts or bugs.
Led agile projects, analyzing requirements, implementing solutions, and collaborating with diverse teams to deliver successful outcomes.
Led daily scrum, sprint planning, and retrospectives, along with other agile practices.

positions.description: Worked on the development of business process automation web applications using Java, JavaEE, GWT, UberFire, Errai, JBPM workflow, JBoss application Server, Hibernate, JPA/JTA  MySQL, AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3 and jQuery.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
For 6 years I worked at Scripps Florida in the Informatics team developing new applications and tools for researchers in areas such as high throughput screening assays, drug metabolism and pharmacology, medicinal chemistry and chemical probe development. I have implemented and developed cheminformatics tools that support the compound management and discovery process. Extensive background developing new applications and features as well as maintaining existing ones. 
During the last 2 years at Scripps I worked as a software developer in the BioAssay Research Database (BARD), a collaboration project between the Molecular Libraries Program, a NIH Common Fund Program and key research centers (Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, The Scripps Research Institute, Vanderbilt University and others).
Designed and developed new applications for scientists to manage and organize experiments' data using  Java, Apache Wicket, JavaScript, Ajax, Oracle DB and Hibernate.
Responsible for maintenance and development of new features to existing and new applications.
Redesigned, implemented and developed Cheminfo, an internal PHP web application for viewing compounds properties as well as performing regular and structured searches on the compounds.
Worked directly with scientists and researchers gathering requirements for new features and changes to existing applications. Facilitated customization of existing tools.
Enhanced  the High Throughput Screening (HTS) NightWatch desktop application via adding  new features such as showing live status for tasks submitted and the ability to redo failed tasks. This is a Java Swing application launched with Java Web Start.

projects.title: BioAssay Research Database (BARD)
projects.description:
BARD is a powerful database for bioassays and their results, a platform for sharing and querying chemical biology data that uses a standard representation and common language for consistent assay/project/experiment organization.
- Worked remotely in a team of 11 engineers and developers from the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard in BARD's web client application using the Scrum agile software development.
- Responsible for developing new features for the web application using Java, Groovy, jQuery, Oracle DB and Grails framework. 
- Wrote unit and integration tests for services and controllers.

publications.title: BioAssay Research Database (BARD): chemical biology and probe-development enabled by structured metadata and result types
publications.publisher: Oxford Journals, Nucleic Acids Research · Dec 1, 2014

publications.title: PubChem promiscuity: a web resource for gathering compound promiscuity data from PubChem
